note: OMIM entries and literature confirm SCA52 is linked to heterozygous RAB3A mutations and includes cerebellar ataxia and ocular signs such as nystagmus.

evidence.text: Spinocerebellar ataxia 52 (SCA52) is confirmed as a distinct subtype caused by heterozygous mutation in the RAB3A gene, with documented eye features including horizontal gaze nystagmus and saccadic pursuit.

evidence.text: SCA52 is recognized as the most recent addition to the spinocerebellar ataxias spectrum, caused by heterozygous mutation in RAB3A.

source.title: From genes to neuropathology: Integrative perspectives on the spectrum of spinocerebellar ataxias
